description.zh: 分页查询时每页行数。其中最大值为100行，默认值为20行。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值。
description.en: The token used to start the next query. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned from the last API call.

description.zh:
权限类型。可能的值：

- Deployable：可部署。

- Accessible：可访问。
description.en:
The permission type. Valid values:

- Deployable: The service is deployable.

- Accessible: The service is accessible.

title.zh: 获取服务共享账号列表

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier list-service-shared-accounts --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-results 20 --next-token AAAAAR130adlM4fHHVSWpTca/t4= --filter '[{"Value":["value1"],"Name":"UserAliUid"}]' --service-id service-e10349089de34exxxxxx --permission Accessible --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun computenestsupplier ListServiceSharedAccounts --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken 'AAAAAR130adlM4fHHVSWpTca/t4=' --Filter.1.Value.1 value1 --MaxResults 20 --Permission Accessible --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Filter.1.Name UserAliUid --ServiceId 'service-e10349089de34exxxxxx'
